components.explanation: Six thin scenes; each level is one Node2D with level.gd and a level_id.
level.gd builds the grid, terrain, props, entities, camera, HUD and overlay from the ASCII maps in levels.gd.
player.gd: input, run, jump, coyote time, jump buffer and jump cut; the playtest-only autopilot hook.
player.gd combo chain and HITS table; hit_flash.gdshader for the white flash.
knife.gd: substepped flight, enemy and rock checks, lifetime; pickup.gd daggers.
enemy.gd base (health, attacks as timed rectangles), walker.gd, bat.gd, plant.gd.
player.gd damage, heal and death; the heart HUD in level.gd.
level.gd door, level complete, game over; GameState campaign and save.
GameState._configure_input builds every key and pad binding at startup.
_unhandled_input, _pause, _resume and _restart in level.gd; the line-761 defect.
main_menu.gd, instructions.gd and credits.gd: title screen, Continue, How to Play, sound button, credits roll.
audio.gd autoload: named sounds, three music loops, the sound toggle; bus layout.
_tools: the level checker and route simulator, the asset synthesizer, a screenshot driver and the playtest.
project.godot (2 autoloads, 1280×720, canvas_items), export presets and README.
The Rocky World sprites, terrain, props, FX, UI images, fonts and synthesized audio, with import settings.

script = ExtResource("1_level")
level_id = 1

func _spawn_entities() -> void:
	for y in range(rows_count):
		for x in range(cols):
			var c := _cell(x, y)
			var foot := Vector2(x * TILE + 8, (y + 1) * TILE)
			var middle := Vector2(x * TILE + 8, y * TILE + 8)
			match c:
				"P":
					player = CharacterBody2D.new()
					player.set_script(preload("res://scripts/player.gd"))
					player.name = "Gino"
					player.level = self
					player.position = foot
					world.add_child(player)
					player.died.connect(_on_player_died)
					player.health_changed.connect(func(_h): _update_hud())
					player.knives_changed.connect(func(_k): _update_hud())
				"b", "w", "p":
					var enemy := CharacterBody2D.new()
					enemy.set_script({"b": preload("res://scripts/bat.gd"), "w": preload("res://scripts/walker.gd"),
						"p": preload("res://scripts/plant.gd")}[c])
					enemy.level = self
					enemy.position = middle if c == "b" else foot
					world.add_child(enemy)
					enemy.died.connect(_on_enemy_died)
					enemies_total += 1

var target := move * RUN_SPEED
	var accel := ACCEL_AIR
	if on_floor:
		accel = ACCEL_GROUND if move != 0.0 else DECEL_GROUND
	if state != "hurt":
		velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, target, accel * delta)

	if state in ["normal", "throw"] and jump_buffer > 0.0 and coyote > 0.0:
		velocity.y = -JUMP_SPEED
		jump_buffer = 0.0
		coyote = 0.0
		can_cut_jump = true
		Audio.play("jump")
	elif can_cut_jump and not input.jump_held and velocity.y < 0.0:
		velocity.y *= JUMP_CUT
		can_cut_jump = false
	if velocity.y >= 0.0:
		can_cut_jump = false
	velocity.y = minf(velocity.y + GRAVITY * delta, MAX_FALL)

func damage(amount: int, from_x: float, knock := Vector2(130, -170)) -> bool:
	if state == "dead" or state == "door" or invulnerable > 0.0:
		return false
	if god_mode:
		invulnerable = INVULNERABLE_TIME
		return true
	health = maxi(0, health - amount)
	health_changed.emit(health)
	Audio.play("dead")    # Unity plays "Dead" on every hit
	_flash()
	level.shake(3.0)
	if health <= 0:
		die()
		return true
	state = "hurt"
	hurt_timer = HURT_TIME
	invulnerable = INVULNERABLE_TIME
	combo_queued = false
	sprite.play("hurt")
	var away := signf(global_position.x - from_x)
	if away == 0.0:
		away = -facing
	velocity = Vector2(away * knock.x, knock.y)
	return true

func _enter_door(who: Node) -> void:
	if state != "play":
		return
	state = "clear"
	prompt_label.visible = false
	Audio.play("door")
	who.enter_door(door.global_position)
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.8, false).timeout
	_level_complete()

func _level_complete() -> void:
	GameState.complete_level(diamonds_found, diamonds_total, enemies_defeated, elapsed)
	Audio.play("level_clear")
	get_tree().paused = true
	var lines := "Score  %d\nDiamonds  %d / %d\nEnemies defeated  %d / %d\nKnives carried  %d\nTime  %s" % [
		GameState.score, diamonds_found, diamonds_total, enemies_defeated, enemies_total,
		GameState.knives, GameState.format_time(elapsed)]
	clear_info.text = lines
	_show_menu(clear_menu)

func _configure_input() -> void:
	_add_keys("move_left", [KEY_A, KEY_LEFT])
	_add_keys("move_right", [KEY_D, KEY_RIGHT])
	_add_keys("jump", [KEY_SPACE])
	_add_keys("attack", [KEY_J, KEY_X])
	_add_keys("throw", [KEY_K, KEY_C])
	_add_keys("enter_door", [KEY_W, KEY_UP])
	_add_keys("confirm", [KEY_ENTER, KEY_KP_ENTER])
	_add_keys("pause", [KEY_ESCAPE, KEY_P])
	_add_keys("restart", [KEY_R])

	_add_joy_button("jump", JOY_BUTTON_A)
	_add_joy_button("attack", JOY_BUTTON_X)
	_add_joy_button("throw", JOY_BUTTON_Y)
	_add_joy_button("throw", JOY_BUTTON_B)
	_add_joy_button("enter_door", JOY_BUTTON_DPAD_UP)
	_add_joy_button("confirm", JOY_BUTTON_A)
	_add_joy_button("pause", JOY_BUTTON_START)
	_add_joy_button("move_left", JOY_BUTTON_DPAD_LEFT)
	_add_joy_button("move_right", JOY_BUTTON_DPAD_RIGHT)
	_add_joy_axis("move_left", JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X, -1.0)
	_add_joy_axis("move_right", JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X, 1.0)
	_add_joy_axis("enter_door", JOY_AXIS_LEFT_Y, -1.0)

code_result_pairs.observation: Level 1 loads fully built: terrain, props, background, HUD, LEVEL 1 ROCKY OUTSKIRTS banner, first hint.
The first walker and diamonds appear at their map positions; the walker turns and runs at Gino.
A held full jump carries Gino over and past a walker at the foot of the rock.
Repeated J presses land single slashes and at most two-hit chains; the walker is knocked back each hit.
The first walker takes repeated 20-damage slashes with a white flash and shake, then dies (+25).
A thrown knife crosses the screen and breaks on the walker; the knife count drops to 0.
A walker waits at a gap edge; after Gino jumps past, its bite costs a full heart; then it is defeated.
Gino throws a knife at a bat, then slashes it down.
Spikes cost half a heart; Gino is knocked back and blinks.
W at the door opens LEVEL COMPLETE: Score 135, Diamonds 6/10, Enemies 3/5, Knives 0, Time 0:43.
Arrow keys run; synthetic pad stick runs; pad A closes a hint; Start pauses and resumes.
R on the pause menu restarts the level; defeat-run.log records the SCRIPT ERROR at level.gd:761.
